one_file_select.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.id END AS id, torrent_files.info_hash, torrent_files.relative_path, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.full_path END AS full_path, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.size END AS size, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.selected END AS selected, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.ui_status END AS ui_status, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.is_checking END AS is_checking, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.media_present END AS media_present, CASE WHEN (torrent_files.info_hash = ANY (%(workbench_active_hashes)s::VARCHAR[])) THEN torrent_files.updated_at END AS updated_at 
FROM torrent_files
